triggering_known-data_result.diagnosis: Forcing one joint weight matrix and the 75-channel intersection removes release-specific observations and compromises both domains.

deployment_model: Fixed algorithm and hyperparameters with per-installation self-supervised commissioning on a normal trace. Model dimensions, weights, robust scaling, residual scaling and the numeric threshold are fitted locally without attack labels.

selection_domain.purpose: Select only algorithmic hyperparameters: context, predictor family, reconstruction rank, residual aggregation, EWMA span and threshold percentile.

final_domain.purpose: Fit target weights and a numeric threshold using normal data only, then commit both before the sealed tests are downloaded.

fairness_constraints: The same selected predictor family, temporal context, reconstruction rank, residual aggregation and EWMA span must be used in both releases.
No final-domain attack label, test header or test value may influence target weights, scaling or threshold.
The threshold percentile is selected on HAI 23.05 known attacks subject to both domains' normal two-events-per-hour ceiling; the HAI 21.03 numeric threshold is then fixed from train3 only.
A candidate must pass every unchanged gate on the combined 52-window HAI 23.05 selection set before target weights may be committed.
Final tests are opened together once and no retraining or retuning follows.
claim_change: The v2 experiment tests whether a fixed self-supervised commissioning procedure transfers across releases, not whether one fixed checkpoint transfers zero-shot.
authority_boundary: A locally fitted diagnostic still cannot authorize or actuate. Normal-only commissioning is not safety certification.
